changelog: The configuration page now uses the whole width it has and clears the dashboard header. Jellyfin caps a settings form at about 800px and floats a fixed header over the page, so the rebuilt page arrived in a narrow column with its top row hidden; it now overrides that cap for itself, measures the header rather than assuming a height, and corrects its own height against the document so no scrollbar is left. The channel rail can also finally tell which channels have no week of their own - the guide says so now - and shows the tag it was always meant to.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
